subject: Create image map for ggplot graphics

messages.author: 96cb2213a1b74f45
messages.subject: Create image map for ggplot graphics
parts:
Hello,
Can anyone suggests ways you can create html image maps for ggplot
graphics? There seem to a be a few different image plot packages that
work on normal R graphics but I couldn't get any of them to work with
ggplot. I also tried using the grconvertX/Y functions to try and pull
out the corresponding pixel positions of certain data points but this
didn't seem to work either. So suggestions very welcome.
thanks
Phil

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Create image map for ggplot graphics
parts:
Hi Phil,

I'm not aware of any solutions for image maps. Instead, you might
want to look at what Paul Murrell has been doing with svg, e.g.
http://www.stat.auckland.ac.nz/~paul/R/gridSVG/

Hadley
